What are brokerage fees? ›

Brokerage fees are charges that brokers levy for executing trades on your behalf. These can include brokerage fees, account maintenance charges, and other transaction costs.

How are brokerage fees calculated? ›

Brokerage fees are typically calculated as a percentage of the trade value or as a flat fee per transaction. The exact calculation method varies by broker.

Can I reduce brokerage fees? ›

Yes, you can reduce brokerage fees by choosing brokers with lower brokerage rates, negotiating fees for high-volume trading, or opting for flat-fee structures.

FAQs

What's included in the free (Access) plan? ›

You can invest globally with full custody under IBKR, view portfolio analytics, and get LRS/FEMA support via our documentation and blogs. No advisory or managed-portfolio services are included.

What's the difference between Access and Apex? ›

Access is self-directed investing; Apex includes advisory, portfolio monitoring, and rebalancing. With Apex, our RIA team builds and maintains a portfolio for you, monitors risk, rebalances when needed, and provides guidance on taxes and remittances.

Can I cancel my Apex plan? ›

You can cancel anytime from your profile. The system will stop automatic deductions, and your account will revert to the free tier at the end of the billing cycle.

Is there a lock-in period? ›

No lock-in, no exit fee. You can cancel anytime - your investments and access remain fully yours.

Do I have to pay extra for remittance support? ›

No. Remittance setup and support with your bank are fully included in your plan.

Do I have to pay extra for tax support? ›

No. Paasa's plans include all tax and LRS documentation support - no hidden or additional fees.

How are fees deducted? ›

Fees are deducted automatically from your Paasa wallet. For Apex customers, fees are deducted at the end of month. Access customers brokerage is deducted at the time of order execution.

Is GST included? ›

For Indian residents, GST is included in the advisory fees charged by our SEBI-registered entity (Arc Spire Advisory Pvt Ltd).

Do you offer family or joint account plans? ›

Yes, we do offer Joint Accounts. Contact us at support@paasa.com to open a Joint account.

Who are the securities held with? ›

All your cash and holdings are held with IBKR under your name and PAN.

What happens if Paasa ceases operations? ›

If Paasa ceases operations, your assets will still be safely held and accessible through IBKR

How is the account SIPC ensured? ›

Your assets are SIPC insured upto $500,000 total, including $250,000 for cash (held for the purpose of trading/securities) through IBKR. This is standard for all U.S. brokers.

Do you earn commissions from ETFs or funds? ›

No. Paasa only recommends clean UCITS ETFs with zero commission trails.

You own your assets

Held with our custodian Interactive Brokers under your name. Assets are SIPC Insured upto $500,000.

content.proposed_work: We propose a contribution reconciliation and customer analysis for the Apex Plan, utilizing recognized service revenue after partner charges minus attributable variable service costs, alongside a cohort rate table measuring the proportion of eligible new customers recording completed orders within the first ninety days. To execute this, we request the entity chart, service/fee-sharing agreements, redacted invoices, revenue ledger, collection and partner-settlement statements, supplier invoices, direct service/support cost records, redacted account-event exports with stable customer keys and event timestamps, and redacted customer/cohort exports with eligibility flags. The concrete deliverable is a source-linked contribution profit table and a source-linked cohort rate table, supporting the commercial decision to investigate loss-making services, choose pricing or delivery-cost work, and select the next activation or retention investigation before any expansion recommendation. We request redacted account-event and customer/cohort exports for the Apex Plan, including stable customer keys, event types, timestamps, plan details, completion/cancellation status, registration dates, eligibility flags, and data cutoffs, with anonymized customer IDs and dates.
content.invitation: Can we schedule a conversation to discuss the scope of these record requests and the next steps for this analysis?
